gui.mostlight.workbench.bulk: Shift + click: craft as many as possible (one stack max)
jei.mostlight.animated: Its moving parts are animated while it is on (when you are close; from far away they stay still to save performance).
jei.mostlight.connector: Right-click near the edge of an LED strip or a lamp block: link / unlink the neighbour on that side (sneak: through the clicked face). Aim at one while holding it: its whole chain is outlined in green (also through walls), neighbours not linked yet in red, and the size of the chain and whether it is powered show under the crosshair.
jei.mostlight.dimmer_switch: Placed: click = next brightness for all linked lamps, sneak + click = on / off.
jei.mostlight.double_switch: Placed: left rocker = light, right rocker = fans of the linked ceiling fan lights.
jei.mostlight.fan: 1st click: light. 2nd click: fan spins. 3rd click: off. The Double Switch controls the light and the fan separately.
jei.mostlight.lamp: Right-click: on / off. Sneak + right-click: brightness (4 levels). Redstone turns it on. Use a dye on it to recolor it.
jei.mostlight.lamp_look: Designer Wrench: change the finish of the frame (Shift + mouse wheel to choose it) and, while sneaking, the light tone.
jei.mostlight.light_switch: Placed: one click turns all linked lamps on or off.
jei.mostlight.remote: Sneak + right-click lamps to link them (64 max, configurable). Right-click in the air: all on / off. Sneak + right-click in the air: brightness.
jei.mostlight.strip: Several strips fit in one block (one per face). Neighbouring strips join automatically like redstone dust: room corners, around pillars, L, T and crosses. Aim low / middle / high to choose the position; sneak on a wall for a vertical strip, on the floor it follows your view.
jei.mostlight.strip_chain: LED Connector: link neighbouring strips and lamp blocks. A whole chain lights up as soon as one of them gets a redstone signal (256 max, configurable).
jei.mostlight.switch_link: Holding the switch, sneak + right-click lamps to link them, then place it. Breaking it keeps its links. Craft it with a dye to change its color.
jei.mostlight.workbench: Every MostLight item is made here, not in a crafting table: pick it in the catalogue, choose its colour, the materials are taken from your inventory.
jei.mostlight.wrench: Shift + mouse wheel: choose a finish. Right-click a lamp: apply it (without a choice: next finish). Sneak + right-click: next light tone.
message.mostlight.no_links: No linked lamps: sneak + right-click lamps with this item before placing it

tooltip.mostlight.double_usage: Placed: left rocker = light, right rocker = fan (ceiling fan lights)
tooltip.mostlight.dye: Dye: recolor - Designer Wrench: finish / light tone
